review_scope.not_examined: Other chains, historical October oracle winners, older unselected pools, local Windows positions without authenticated receipts

why: All reviewed markets lack independent D3-04/D3-05 and verifiable executable quotes/client authorization.
follow_up: Dot3 independently authenticate issuer, chain sellability, provider quote origin and executable route; Dot5 verify external client receipt; retain source-as-of provenance.

observations.counterargument: Observed liquidity and indicative cross-domain prices may support monitoring, but neither proves upstream independence or sellability.
